parcalar.metin: Clay tablets from Ugarit, in Syria, already warned about the evil eye. It began in Mesopotamia... then spread to Egypt, Greece and Rome.
The Greek philosopher Plutarch said: the eye... shoots rays! The Romans hung a strange charm on their doors. Its shape? Let's not say... it's carved in stone at Leptis Magna!

And the protection? Every culture made its own. Greeks wear the blue mati. Italians carry a red horn. In the Middle East... the hand of Fatima. And in Mexico, grandmothers roll an egg over your forehead... to pull the eye out!
